changelog.content:
## Features

- Unified Application Center creation for local applications and exact public
  store releases. Imports create drafts with linked versions and mapped native
  binaries; publication remains an explicit action.
- Consolidated HTTP proxies and TCP forwarding in Super Gateway, with shared
  status labels and creation controls.
- Added resumable signed fleet updates that update Master/Core first and then
  Slave/Core pairs, including offline and newly connected nodes.
- Added a mesh interconnection switch, enabled by default, allowing all ports
  and protocols between authenticated overlay addresses. Disabling it restores
  the existing protected-control-port and established-reply policy.

## Fixes

- Corrected mesh firewall rules that prevented ICMP and other node-to-node
  service traffic, while retaining isolation for physical and LAN destinations.
- Confined list horizontal scrolling to the table container without changing
  natural table widths; the sidebar and page no longer expand around wide lists.
- Fixed narrow-screen application details, market selection, and node enrollment
  forms with long names, versions, and addresses in both supported languages.
- Removed redundant system-update and workflow hints from management lists.
